{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of research and development expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile R&D expenses may face higher uncertainty and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased risk. This volatility can be a proxy for the firm's ability to innovate and adapt to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Acceleration", "construction": "change in capital expenditures over the past year, scaled by total assets, minus the average change over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms that rapidly increase their capital expenditures may be undertaking risky and potentially value-creating investments, and therefore require a higher expected return. This acceleration can be a proxy for the firm's investment opportunities and growth prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Dispersion", "construction": "standard deviation of inventory turnover over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more variable inventory turnover may face higher operational risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This dispersion can be a proxy for the firm's ability to manage its supply chain and respond to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Days Variability", "construction": "standard deviation of days accounts payable over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more variable accounts payable days may face higher financial risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This variability can be a proxy for the firm's ability to manage its working capital and respond to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Ratio Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of advertising expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by total sales", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile advertising expenses may face higher marketing risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This volatility can be a proxy for the firm's ability to manage its brand and respond to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Property, Plant, and Equipment Obsolescence", "construction": "average age of property, plant, and equipment, weighted by net book value", "rationale": "Firms with older property, plant, and equipment may face higher technological risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This obsolescence can be a proxy for the firm's ability to invest in new technologies and respond to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Audit Qualified Opinion Frequency", "construction": "number of years with an audit qualified opinion over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more frequent audit qualified opinions may face higher governance risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This frequency can be a proxy for the firm's ability to manage its financial reporting and respond to changing regulatory conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Off-Balance-Sheet Liability Growth", "construction": "change in off-balance-sheet liabilities over the past year, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing off-balance-sheet liabilities may face higher financial risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This growth can be a proxy for the firm's ability to manage its financial leverage and respond to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Top Executive Team Tenure Dispersion", "construction": "standard deviation of top executive team members' tenure", "rationale": "Firms with more variable top executive team tenure may face higher management risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This dispersion can be a proxy for the firm's ability to manage its leadership and respond to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Underfunding", "construction": "pension plan underfunding, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with more underfunded pension plans may face higher financial risk and therefore require a higher expected return to compensate investors for the increased uncertainty. This underfunding can be a proxy for the firm's ability to manage its long-term obligations and respond to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
